speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey finger (avulsion of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon from the distal phalanx of the right ring finger).

This diagnosis is based on the classic mechanism of injury you described (finger caught and pulled), the specific location of your pain and swelling, and the fact that your X-ray did not show a fracture.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
